t: You are standing at the Prudential World War I Memorial. It was made by Ferdinand Victor Blundstone, a sculptor who was born in Switzerland and worked in England. His father, Charles, was an India rubber merchant, and Blundstone studied at the South London Technical Art School and then at the Royal Academy Schools. He lived from 1882 to 1951. This is a memorial to the First World War, so take a moment to look at the figures and any names or inscriptions on it.
